power.plantText: Mass reactor rated at 5 power factors

defenses.name: Jammer
defenses.effectText: +2 steps to enemy missile and sensor checks.

systems.name: Configurable section
systems.notes: One point of crew quarters (6 hands), passenger section (4 passengers) or cargo hold (~30 cubic metres). Four hours to re-partition.

system.notes: One of the smallest interplanetary craft built anywhere, usually carried as a ship's boat. Quick and responsive, and capable of supporting its crew for weeks, but notoriously underpowered - its installed systems draw 7 power factors against a plant rated for 5, so the crew cannot run everything at once.
